Good Test Studio About the studio

Calm bodywork sessions in Austin, TX

Sessions

Good Test Studio offers calm, unhurried bodywork sessions in Austin, TX for people carrying stress in their shoulders, jaw and back. Each first visit starts with a short conversation about what brings you in, what you would like to feel afterward, and anything your body has been telling you lately. Sessions run sixty or ninety minutes in a quiet room with soft light, warm towels and music you choose. We work at the pace you set, check in often, and never push past what feels right. Many clients come once a month to reset; others come weekly through a hard season. Parking is free behind the building, and the studio is a short walk from the bus line on the main road. You can book online any time, call or text during the day, or send an email with questions before you decide. Gift cards are available for friends and family who could use an hour of rest.
